info.title: WildCrane API
info.description: Tasks, workflows, checkpoints, artifacts, decisions and memory, and the events they write. See cloud/endpoints.md for authentication, pagination, errors, idempotency and the compatibility promise.

post.description: Needs a signed-in session; an API key cannot create keys. The key is shown once.

delete.description: Needs a signed-in session. Takes effect at once.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Retrying with the same key and body answers the first response.

delete.description: Deletes its project memory. Its tasks remain, with no project.

get.description: Built-in workflows first, then the account's own.

patch.description: Built-in workflows are read-only. Running tasks keep the definition they started with.

put.description: At most 50 MB. Once per upload.

post.description: Decisions never change; the latest sets the checkpoint's status. Defaults to the latest version submitted to the checkpoint.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Only what this task may read: user memory and its project's.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: An event id; omit or pass empty to start from the oldest kept.

get.description: Oldest first. Events are kept 30 days.

200.description: Server-sent events: `id` is the event id, `event` its type, `data` the event.

bearer.description: A WildCrane sign-in token, or an API key (`wck_…`).

prefix.description: The first characters of the key, to tell keys apart.

key.description: The key itself. Returned only here, once.

artifact_type.description: The review component the artifact previews in, e.g. `web-page`.

workflow.description: The workflow as it stood when the task was created.

content.description: Inline JSON, or null for a file.

url.description: Path to read the file through.

decided_by.description: `{ kind: user, handle }` or `{ kind: api_key, id, name }`.

data.description: The resource as it stands after the change.
